## What's Changed

- Keep explicit search/query requests on the investigation path, retrying a misclassified request with a data plan.
- Skip unrelated playbook and histogram work for targeted record searches.
- Ask for a field clarification instead of falling back to an unfiltered scan when no safe query can be formed.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.6.2-rc...0.6.3-rc
